improvements: posterior distillation using fixed continuous quadrature measure
validation_selection: minimum posterior-expected continuous material negative log density; same rule for all four methods
secondary_selection_record: observed validation true-material log score recorded separately, not used to select primary models
data: existing C1 train/validation only; parents/noise replicates/normalization unchanged; distillation adds numerical posterior target information explicitly
old_tests: exposed regression panels, never described as blind
events: four sign regions, defined after generation for evaluation only; no sign/topology input
event_mass_evaluation: normalized Gaussian mixture CDF with independent 32/64 point Plackett integral refinement; no 1024-draw Monte Carlo ranking
diagnostic_round_1: fixed first eight validation observations; non-amortized weighted EM family-capacity diagnostic, two starts, 60 steps, no topology initialization
diagnostic_round_2: reserved for one recorded numerical/training diagnosis if needed; not an unlimited model search
state_ablation: only if measurement-only repair improves KL and event MAE in all three seeds; P0 cached existing states only, same density and target/selection rule, no physical refresh

quality_targets.interpretation: scientific target, not new execution or publication approval flow

unmetered_scope: interactive reading/writing, model-service reasoning and delegation are not included in controlled numerical job timers; not claimed free
old_ledgers: read only, not reset or reinterpreted
